[[General]] '''Dustil Forell''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served as the head of [[Support Services]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He and other members of [[Alliance High Command]] attended a meeting in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] in [[1 BBY]], where the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] was discussed. He was later part of the Alliance forces that gathered in the [[Sullust system]] before the [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]], and attended a briefing on ''[[Home One]]'', [[flagship]] of [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]].

==Biography==
Dustil Forell was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[general]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Part of [[Alliance High Command]], he oversaw the [[Support Services]] division,<ref name="Visual Guide" /> which was a thankless task<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|general-dustil-forell|General Dustil Forell}}</ref> dedicated to the Alliance's anemic transportation network. Forell was part of the [[Massassi Group]] based in the rebel headquarters in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]], where the transportation network encompassed<ref name="Visual Guide" /> less than a dozen medium [[freighter]]s<ref name="Databank" /> and one military-converted [[light freighter]].<ref name="Visual Guide" /> A classified intelligence document titled Form #49021804-REB that listed Forell as one of the members of the Alliance's Rebel Council was included in the collection of documents that became known as ''[[The Rebel Files]]''.<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>
[[File:Forrel-Meeting-RO.png|thumb|left|300px|Dustil Forell attended a meeting in the Great Temple.]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|RO}}</ref> Forell attended a meeting in the Great Temple where the Alliance High Command discussed information brought to them by the criminal [[Jyn Erso]], who claimed that the [[Galactic Empire]] was building a [[superweapon]] known as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], which was capable of destroying [[planet]]s and that the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the weapon, which would reveal a weakness, were being stored on the planet [[Scarif]].<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

She proposed that the Alliance must mobilize to seize the plans, but the council could not reach agreement and so no attack was authorized.
Forell, who had been stood behind [[senator]]s [[Vasp Vaspar]] and [[Tynnra Pamlo]], then dispersed with the rest of the crowd as the meeting ended. Erso ultimately led an unauthorized [[Rogue One|squad]] to Scarif to steal the plans, which forced the Alliance to mobilize and engage the Empire at the [[Battle of Scarif]], where they successfully acquired the plans.<ref name="RO" />

The Alliance used the plans to destroy the [[Death Star]] at the [[Battle of Yavin]], after which they entirely [[Evacuation of Yavin 4|evacuated]] the Great Temple in [[0 ABY]]. In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Forell was among the Alliance forces that amassed in the [[Sullust system]] in preparation for an attack on the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]]. He was among the rebel leaders who were summoned onto [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]]'s [[flagship]], ''[[Home One]]'', where a briefing on the attack was given. Forell served as one of the leaders of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] when it traveled to the [[Endor system]] and successfully destroyed the Death Star at the [[Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Odyssey">''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''</ref> He survived the battle and, several [[Standard day|days]] after, approached [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] so that she could record a message for the [[Anoat sector]], which had been [[Iron Blockade|blockaded]] by a [[Ubrik Adelhard's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the Empire to prevent news of [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] [[death]] reaching the [[sector]]'s occupants. The message gave assurance that the [[Emperor]] was dead and that the [[New Republic|new, unified Republic]], would come to the aid of those being [[blockade]]d.<ref name="P&S">''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Dustil Forell knew that the meager transportation resources of the Great Temple were inadequate and that an evacuation would strain them to breaking point. He had [[Color|light]] skin, brown and gray [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="Databank" />

==Equipment==
At the Great Temple, Forell wore a brown [[Clothing|shirt]] with tan pants and a brown [[belt]]. Over the shirt he wore a tan [[jacket]] that was part of traditional [[Alderaanian]] military livery<ref name="Visual Guide" /> and a [[tactician's overcoat]]<ref name="RO" /> that was also part of an Alderaanian custom.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dustil Forell appeared in the [[2017]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="RO" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="Visual Guide" />
